notes: Version 3.7 corrects the section on the projection structure. The statement that admissible injective projections have trivial holonomy, previously adopted as a reading not proved here, is now cited from the white paper (Appendix A.9, Theorem A.1 and Corollary A.1) in its exact scope: for an admissible projection in the white paper's sense, a smooth fibre-bundle map supporting a connection, injectivity makes every fibre a single point, so that in the principal case the structure group and the holonomy group are trivial and the fibre connection is flat. The paper states that it does not establish that its projection satisfies these hypotheses. The sentences that drew from this a conclusion on the curvature of the effective geometry are removed. A footnote corrects the provenance of the finite-q values of the admissibility weight quoted up to version 3.4 and withdrawn in version 3.5: they are reproducible from the simulation code published with Q5a; their modulation terms equal 2 exactly by the normalisation of the fingerprint vectors on full-rank pairs, their shift terms are only numerically close to 2 on average, and they do not bear on Hypothesis [H-w], which remains open. All theorems and results of the paper are unchanged.
